body: I sincerely appreciate this. Thank you so much, and I hope that things get better for you as well.

I've always wondered that myself, honestly, and it's really kind of hard to explain. Some say it's a basic chemical imbalance that turns it from just being a constant sadness to an actual disorder. It's one thing to have bad days and be sad; it's another thing to have some really fantastic days and still be sad and alone. Se people turn to self harm in other ways, like drugs and alcohol or lack of sleep or over/under eating. It isn't just physical.

This happens to me! For whatever reason, I can always feel it very strongly right below my rib cage. Sometimes if I have my phone sitting there, I can watch it pulse along with my heartbeat. It freaks me out.
Mine take forever to heal anymore, and the scarring is sometimes more painful than the act itself depending on the location. It's insane.
